title: Have to vs Mustn't
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes cómo expresar obligaciones, opciones y prohibiciones en el trabajo.

parts.visual:
Obligación (Es necesario hacerlo): HAVE TO. 
Ejemplo: You have to wear a uniform (Tienes que usar uniforme). 
She has to arrive at 9 AM (Ella tiene que llegar a las 9).
parts.audio: Obligation. To say something is necessary, we use 'have to'. For example: You have to wear a uniform. Or, she has to arrive at 9 A.M.

parts.visual:
Opción (No es necesario, pero puedes hacerlo si quieres): DON'T HAVE TO. 
Ej: You don't have to work on Sundays (No tienes que trabajar los domingos).
parts.audio: Lack of obligation. To say something is not necessary, but you can do it if you want, we use 'don't have to'. For example: You don't have to work on Sundays.

parts.visual:
Prohibición (Está prohibido, NO lo hagas): MUST NOT (MUSTN'T). 
Ej: You mustn't smoke in the office (No debes fumar en la oficina).
parts.audio: Prohibition. To say something is strictly forbidden, we use 'must not', or 'mustn't'. For example: You mustn't smoke in the office.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige 'have to', 'don't have to' o 'mustn't' según el contexto.

questions.question: The meeting is mandatory. You ____ attend. (Es obligatorio).
Tomorrow is a holiday. We ____ go to work! (No es necesario/No tenemos que).
questions.explanation: 'Don't have to' indica falta de obligación (no es necesario).

questions.question: You ____ share your password with anyone. It's against company policy. (Prohibición).
She ____ wear a suit every day because she works in a bank. (Tiene que).
You ____ pay for the coffee. It's free for employees. (No tienes que).
questions.explanation: Como es gratis, no es necesario pagar = 'don't have to'.

questions.question: We ____ arrive late to the meeting with the CEO. (No debemos/Prohibido).
questions.explanation: Llegar tarde está prohibido/muy mal visto = 'mustn't'.

questions.question: He ____ work overtime if he doesn't want to. (No tiene que).
Do I ____ sign this paper? (¿Tengo que...?).
Does she ____ travel a lot for her job? (¿Tiene ella que...?).
questions.explanation: Con 'Does' el verbo vuelve a su forma base 'have to'.

questions.question: You ____ smoke in the office. It's illegal. (Prohibición).
The presentation is ready. You ____ do anything else. (No tienes que).
questions.explanation: Ya está listo, así que no hay necesidad = 'don't have to'.

questions.question: I ____ finish this report by 5 PM. It's the deadline. (Tengo que).
questions.explanation: Es obligatorio cumplir la fecha límite = 'have to'.

questions.question: You ____ use your phone during the training session. (No debes/Prohibido).
You ____ come to the party if you are tired. (No tienes que/Es opcional).
John is the boss. He ____ report to anyone in this office. (No tiene que).
We ____ wear safety glasses in the factory. (Tenemos que).
They ____ bring their laptops. We have computers here. (No tienen que).
questions.explanation: Ya hay computadoras, por lo que no es necesario traerlas = 'don't have to'.

questions.question: You ____ tell the competitors about our new product! (Prohibición).
questions.explanation: Secreto de la empresa, prohibido contarlo = 'mustn't'.

questions.question: I ____ wake up early tomorrow. My flight is at 6 AM. (Tengo que).
She ____ buy the ticket. The company pays for it. (No tiene que).
questions.explanation: La empresa paga, así que ella no tiene la necesidad de comprarlo = 'doesn't have to'.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa con 'have to', 'has to', 'don't have to', 'doesn't have to' o 'mustn't'.

questions.question: You ____ wear a uniform. (Obligación - tú)
She ____ arrive at 9. (Obligación - ella)
We ____ work on Sunday. (No tenemos que/Opcional)
He ____ pay for coffee. (No tiene que/Opcional)
You ____ smoke here. (Prohibición)
You ____ share your password. (Prohibición)
I ____ finish this today. (Obligación - yo)
Do I ____ sign this? (Tener que)
Does she ____ travel? (Tener que)
You ____ tell anyone! It's a secret. (Prohibición)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
